title: Identification of ducts.
officialText:
All duct systems serving Type I and Type II exhaust equipment shall be permanently labeled:
“CAUTION: KITCHEN EXHAUST SYSTEM.”
SECTION MC 507
COMMERCIAL KITCHEN HOODS
